title: Shape Size Panel (AlignAndSize)

scenarios.title: Shape Size Panel applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Shape Size Panel (BtnSizePanel) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Shape Size Panel decisions (conversion, parsing, floor, change detection, uniform display) pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The production rules pin: the 28.3464567 pt/cm conversion both ways; typed dimension parsing strips the pt/cm suffix (pt converts to cm) and falls back across current culture, invariant culture and comma-replaced invariant (de-DE '12,5' and en-US '12.5' work, junk/empty/null rejected, NaN/Infinity rejected); typed values must be positive; stepping floors at the 0.01 cm minimum; the apply change detection skips zero/NaN/Infinity targets and differences below the 0.001 pt epsilon (float reality: a difference of exactly the epsilon constant counts as uniform, 100 vs 100.01 pt is mixed); and the panel delegates all rules instead of inlining them (the local PtsPerCm constant is gone).
